Module media.barney.contract.core

Package media.barney.contract.runtime

@NullMarked package media.barney.contract.runtime
Runtime bridge invoked by annotation-processor-generated contract checks.

Types in this package are part of the supported generated-code surface; applications normally use media.barney.contract annotations directly.

Generated checks call this package to evaluate built-in semantic contracts, render masked values, and throw the documented JDK exception types. Parameter and constructor-parameter precondition failures throw IllegalArgumentException; return-value postcondition failures throw IllegalStateException. Exact generated bytecode shape and packages named internal are not public API.
